row.proto: void Ui_Font_Measure_Utf8Range(void *font, float *out_xyzw, const uint8_t *begin, const uint8_t *end, const float *style)
row.notes: Measures a UTF-8 range: decodes codepoints, maps missing ones to the default char (font+0x40 -> +8), applies case remap when style+0x54 is 1 or 2, sums glyph advance (+0x18,+0x1c) plus kerning from table font+0x850 and letter spacing style+0x50; digits use fixed width style+0x5c when style+0x58 is set; newline (10) starts a new row. Writes max width*style[0], height*style[0] and a third metric to out.
